limitations: Authored synthetic known-answer controls test evaluator sensitivity, not real agent performance.
Expected target labels are authored, not independent human calibration; nine cases are not a representative benchmark.
The evaluator shares the Gemini model family with the agent and can share its biases.
Stored text and fictional scheduler evidence do not verify spoken audio, recognition, pronunciation, consent heard, or caller satisfaction.
Scores in this experiment must not be mixed with live-call production averages.

public_copy.readback_scope: Historical API readback of private resources. Counts and check results are retained; target identifiers, names and URLs are withheld in this public copy.
public_copy.navigation: Sign in to your authorized workspace, then select the dataset and experiment created by your own evaluation run. The general entry URL is not a verified link to the private experiment.
